meta.name: atlassian-templates
meta.description: Atlassian Template and Files Creator/Modifier expert for creating, modifying, and managing Jira and Confluence templates, blueprints, custom layouts, reusable components, and standardized content structures. Use when building org-wide templates, custom blueprints, page layouts, and automated content generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和管理团队模板与内容结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Jira和Confluence中统一团队模板和内容格式。
copy.tagline_en: Create and manage team templates and content structures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to standardize templates and content in Jira and Confluence.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能创建和修改 Jira 与 Confluence 的模板，包括会议记录、项目章程等，并生成可直接部署的存储格式内容。
howto.when: 当你需要为团队或组织创建、修改或管理 Jira 和 Confluence 的标准化模板、蓝图或页面布局时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个会议记录模板，包含议程和行动项。
更新项目章程模板，添加状态宏。
say.note: Claude 会修改现有模板并保留旧版本。

say.text: 为 Jira 创建一个用户故事模板，包含验收标准。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Jira 问题描述模板文本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and modify templates for Jira and Confluence, including meeting notes, project charters, etc., and generate deployment-ready storage-format content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create, modify, or manage standardized templates, blueprints, or page layouts for Jira and Confluence for teams or organizations.

say_en.text: Create a meeting notes template with agenda and action items.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Confluence storage-format content.

say_en.text: Update the project charter template to add a status macro.
say_en.note: Claude will modify the existing template and keep the old version.

say_en.text: Create a user story template for Jira with acceptance criteria.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Jira issue description template text.
